destination.title: Physical solutions, spectra and dynamical response
destination.question: How do specified equations, matter sectors, states and boundary conditions determine physical solutions, spectra, evolution and response in field-theoretic and gravitational systems?
destination.summary: A common physical-calculation direction retains separate geometry, orbit, perturbation, emission, transport and production questions. Ordinary calculations need no conjectural completion premise.

systems: Black holes and related gravitational configurations
Holographic field theories and quantum matter
Driven charged fields and thermal gauge theories
Specified cosmological and curved-spacetime field backgrounds
targets: Perturbation spectra, stability diagnostics and classical motion
Transport, relaxation, production, emission and electric response
regimes: Classical backgrounds, test fields and coupled dynamics
Equilibrium, initially populated and driven systems
Source-specific extremal, near-extremal and nonextremal limits
Weak-field, semiclassical, perturbative and selected exact calculations
assumptions: Actions, states, boundary conditions and control conditions remain attached to each question.
Kinematic permission does not determine a rate.
A fixed-background calculation does not establish backreaction or a nonlinear endpoint.
conventions: Occupation, vacuum persistence, emitted flux and current are different observables.
Quasinormal damping, orbital instability and many-body growth are not identified.
Initial thermality does not imply equilibrium during driving.
includes: Equilibrium spectral calculations as a distinct neighboring scope
excludes: Universal stability inferred from selected modes
Generic black-hole discharge inferred from a flat-background production exponent

sources.title: Thermal Schwinger pair production at arbitrary coupling

evidence.text: What is the leading exponential suppression of thermal Schwinger pair production at arbitrary charge coupling in weak external fields, and what inclusive fixed-energy rates follow?

sources.title: Schwinger pair production at finite temperature in scalar QED

evidence.text: How should an initial thermal fermion state be propagated through a time-dependent electric background, and how does the produced current alter that background? Both questions require ingredients beyond the fixed-background bosonic occupation calculation.

sources.title: Viscosity Bound Violation in Higher Derivative Gravity

evidence.text: Can curvature-squared corrections violate the conjectured KSS bound η/s ≥ 1/(4π), and do violations correlate with bulk pathologies, inconsistent boundary theories, or restrictions on quantum-gravity embeddings?

sources.title: The Viscosity Bound and Causality Violation

evidence.text: Does reducing shear viscosity in the Gauss-Bonnet holographic model eventually violate boundary microcausality, thereby imposing a consistency-related lower bound on η/s?

sources.title: Building a Holographic Superconductor

evidence.text: Can a simple gravitational model describe a strongly coupled 2+1-dimensional system with a charged condensate, a superconducting transition and a gap in its frequency-dependent conductivity?

sources.title: (Un)attractor black holes in higher derivative AdS gravity

evidence.text: How do Gauss–Bonnet corrections affect renormalized charges, thermodynamics and scalar attractor behavior of static charged AdS black holes, including extremal solutions?

sources.title: Holographic Superconductors

evidence.text: How do gravitational backreaction and arbitrary scalar charge affect holographic condensation and transport, and what magnetic response, critical fields and photon mass follow from the model?

sources.title: Real time response on dS(3): The Topological AdS Black Hole and the Bubble

evidence.text: How do real-time correlators distinguish the topological black hole and bubble phases of strongly coupled N=4 SYM on dS3 × S1, reveal cosmological thermal effects, and characterize charge relaxation?

sources.title: Landscape versus Swampland for Higher Derivative Gravity

evidence.text: Can consistency requirements on holographic boundary theories distinguish negative-cosmological-constant Gauss–Bonnet gravity theories belonging to the string landscape from those in the swampland, and what do these examples imply for viscosity bounds?

sources.title: Holographic Hydrodynamics with a Chemical Potential

evidence.text: How do general four-derivative bulk interactions change finite-chemical-potential thermodynamics, shear viscosity and conductivity, and what happens to conjectured transport bounds?

sources.title: Higher derivative effects on eta/s at finite chemical potential

evidence.text: Does a finite U(1)R chemical potential modify η/s once supersymmetric four-derivative corrections are included, and does it strengthen or weaken violation of the proposed 1/(4π) viscosity bound?

sources.title: Emergent quantum criticality, Fermi surfaces, and AdS(2)

evidence.text: How does the near-horizon geometry control low-frequency retarded correlators, Fermi-surface excitations and possible instabilities of strongly coupled finite-density systems?

sources.title: Quantum instability for charged scalar particles on charged Nariai and ultracold black hole manifolds

evidence.text: What vacuum pair-production instability does a charged scalar exhibit on charged ultracold I, ultracold II and Nariai backgrounds, and how does background thermality modify particle production?

sources.title: Fundamental Strings and Higher Derivative Corrections to d-Dimensional Black Holes

evidence.text: What are the leading α′ corrections to d-dimensional black holes carrying fundamental-string momentum and winding charges, and how do those corrections affect gravitational thermodynamics, entropy and mass/charge relations?

sources.title: Towards strange metallic holography

evidence.text: Can controlled holographic models of finite-density, gapped charge carriers coupled to a neutral Lifshitz critical sector reproduce anomalous DC, optical, and Hall transport associated with strange metals?

sources.title: Black Strings, Low Viscosity Fluids, and Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: What is the nonlinear endpoint of the Gregory–Laflamme instability of a five-dimensional black string, and can its horizon develop arbitrarily large curvature visible to exterior observers in finite asymptotic time?

sources.title: Final state of Gregory–Laflamme instability

evidence.text: What is the nonlinear endpoint of the Gregory–Laflamme instability of a five-dimensional vacuum black string, and does its evolution imply a naked singularity in finite time measured by asymptotic observers?

sources.title: The Shear Viscosity to Entropy Ratio: A Status Report

evidence.text: What explains holographic universality of η/s, how do higher-curvature, finite-N and finite-coupling effects violate or preserve the KSS bound, and can microscopic consistency impose a replacement lower bound?

sources.title: Gravitation and tunnelling: Subtleties of the thin-wall approximation and rapid decays

evidence.text: When does gravitational backreaction change the thin-wall tunnelling exponent, and which scalar potentials admit rapid transitions between perturbatively stable minima?

sources.title: Coleman-de Luccia reconsidered: a subtlety of gravity and the thin wall approximation

evidence.text: Does the usual thin-wall evaluation of gravitational vacuum-decay instantons omit backreaction in the action subtraction, and how would retaining it change tunnelling exponents and proposed metastable de Sitter lifetimes?

sources.title: Holographic Q-lattices

evidence.text: Can explicit holographic lattices be constructed using ODEs, and can they realize metallic and insulating transport? Does the resulting optical conductivity exhibit the proposed intermediate-frequency power law?

sources.title: Schwinger effect in de Sitter space

evidence.text: What current does Schwinger production generate in dS₂ beyond the heavy-particle semiclassical regime, and what does it imply for de Sitter invariance, upward/downward tunneling, and persistent dependence on initial conditions?

sources.title: Schwinger Effect in (A)dS and Charged Black Hole

evidence.text: How do electric-field pair production, de Sitter radiation and negative curvature interact, can global dS₂ Schwinger production exhibit Stokes interference, and how can near-extremal charged-black-hole emission be interpreted thermally?

sources.title: End Point of Black Ring Instabilities and the Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture

evidence.text: What are the nonlinear endpoints of black-ring instabilities, and can sufficiently thin rings provide evidence for weak cosmic censorship violation in asymptotically flat five-dimensional gravity?

sources.title: Tunneling method for Hawking radiation in the Nariai case

evidence.text: Can exact field solutions on charged Nariai spacetime corroborate Hamilton–Jacobi tunneling for Hawking radiation, and what probability does the usual semiclassical emission factor represent?

sources.title: Evidence for an Electrifying Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: Can localized electric boundary forcing in four-dimensional asymptotically AdS Einstein–Maxwell theory drive smooth initial data toward arbitrarily large curvature visible to distant observers, providing a counterexample to the version of cosmic censorship considered here?

sources.title: Generalized Charged Nariai Solutions in Arbitrary Even Dimensions with Multiple Magnetic Charges

evidence.text: Can even-dimensional charged Nariai geometries built from two-dimensional factors carry several magnetic charges, arise as limits of black-hole solutions, and extend to gravitational theories with higher-curvature terms?

sources.title: End Point of the Ultraspinning Instability and Violation of Cosmic Censorship

evidence.text: What is the nonlinear endpoint of the axisymmetric ultraspinning instability of six-dimensional Myers–Perry black holes, and does its evolution provide evidence for a violation of weak cosmic censorship?

sources.title: Violating the Weak Cosmic Censorship Conjecture in Four-Dimensional Anti–de Sitter Space

evidence.text: Can initially pure four-dimensional AdS, driven by a localized boundary electric field, develop arbitrarily large curvature visible to boundary observers, violating the version of weak cosmic censorship considered here?

sources.title: A proof of the instability of AdS for the Einstein--null dust system with an inner mirror

evidence.text: Can arbitrarily small, Cauchy-stable perturbations of AdS develop trapped surfaces through repeated reflections, in the spherically symmetric Einstein–null dust model with a shrinking inner mirror?

sources.title: Schwinger pair production at finite temperature in scalar QED

evidence.text: Separate the transverse magnetic eigenproblem from the longitudinal electric dynamics and substitute its eigenvalues into the pure-electric frequency. Apply the substitution consistently to asymptotic energies, hypergeometric parameters, and initial Bose occupations.

sources.title: Viscosity Bound Violation in Higher Derivative Gravity

evidence.text: The authors report agreement among four methods: Kubo and stretched-horizon calculations nonperturbative in λGB, plus shear diffusion and sound attenuation poles at linear order. The membrane calculation uses Kaluza-Klein reduction to a generalized Maxwell action.

sources.title: The Viscosity Bound and Causality Violation

evidence.text: Expand the action to quadratic order in h₁₂, Fourier transform as e^{−iωt+iqx₃}, and obtain its radial wave equation. The retarded stress-tensor correlator gives η in the small-frequency, small-momentum limit.

sources.title: Building a Holographic Superconductor

evidence.text: Compute zero-spatial-momentum conductivity from an Ax perturbation with e^{-iωt} dependence and ingoing horizon boundary conditions. Use its boundary coefficients for linear response and Kramers–Kronig relations to associate an imaginary pole with a real conductivity delta function.

sources.title: (Un)attractor black holes in higher derivative AdS gravity

evidence.text: Evaluate the Euclidean on-shell action through radial total derivatives, obtain entropy through the Gibbs–Duhem relation, and compare with Wald’s horizon Noether-charge formula.

sources.title: Holographic Superconductors

evidence.text: Solve the fully backreacted radial equations by numerical shooting from a regular horizon, imposing source-free scalar boundary conditions. Compare equilibrium free energies using the regulated Euclidean action with gravitational and scalar boundary counterterms.

sources.title: Weak gravity conjecture from conformal field theory: a challenge from hyperscaling violating and Kerr-Newman-AdS black holes

evidence.text: Can charged-scalar CFT correlation functions and their relaxation poles imply weak gravity conjecture conditions for hyperscaling violating (HSV) and Kerr-Newman-AdS (KNA) black holes, particularly near extremality?

sources.title: Are we typical?

evidence.text: How should one ask what observers could have measured if a now-known quantity had been unknown? The paper requires a physical specification of which records may vary and which features continue to identify the conditioning system.

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Does gauge invariance itself prevent local observables and time evolution? Introducing coordinate fields in nondynamical flat geometry shows that the relevant obstruction is dynamical gravity, which makes causal separation fluctuate and requires physical clocks.

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Can low-curvature Hamiltonian evolution on nice slices describe an entire unitary evaporation? The reviewed paradox contrasts the entropy increase predicted by independent interior and exterior degrees of freedom with the shrinking information capacity assigned to the hole.

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Can all subsystem entropies of one holographic state determine its classical bulk geometry? The proposed advantage over null-endpoint data is sensitivity to the metric's conformal factor and access to deeper bulk regions.

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Can entanglement between otherwise noninteracting boundary theories explain nonzero correlations associated with a connected multiple-boundary bulk wormhole?

sources.title: An area law for one-dimensional quantum systems

evidence.text: How much entanglement can occur across a cut in the unique ground state of a finite one-dimensional chain when interaction range, interaction strength, and the excitation gap are controlled?

sources.title: On Super-Planckian Fields at Sub-Planckian Energies

evidence.text: Assuming super-Planckian scalar ranges exist, can an observer in asymptotically flat space source and measure them in a finite local experiment without excessive gravitational backreaction or collapse?

sources.title: Relative entropy and the Bekenstein bound

evidence.text: Can the Bekenstein bound receive an unambiguous flat-space QFT formulation using localized, vacuum-subtracted entropy and modular energy, and does that formulation follow from semiclassical generalized-second-law arguments without an additional physical principle?

sources.title: Quantum gravity without space-time singularities or horizons

evidence.text: Can quantum gravity retain spacetime, locality and strong causality while accommodating black-hole complementarity without physical singularities or horizons, by making the local metric scale an observer-dependent redundancy?

sources.title: Holography and wormholes in 2+1 dimensions

evidence.text: How does real-time holography encode topology hidden behind horizons when every outer region is a static BTZ exterior? The apparent mismatch is between m exterior mass parameters and 6g−6+3m surface moduli in the general construction.

sources.title: Constructing local bulk observables in interacting AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can CFT operators represent interacting bulk observables beyond leading large N while satisfying bulk locality, defined as commutation at spacelike separation?

sources.title: Probing AdS Wormholes by Entanglement Entropy

evidence.text: What do holographic entanglement entropy and probe-brane conductivity reveal about the dual interpretation of a smooth Lorentzian geometry connecting an AdS region to flat space, particularly the expected entanglement between its two asymptotic regions?

sources.title: Bulk and Transhorizon Measurements in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can effective bulk observables, including measurements behind an AdS black-hole horizon, be represented in the dual CFT? In particular, can the CFT encode a measurement distinguishing a live from a dead cat behind the horizon?

sources.title: Construction of Bulk Fields with Gauge Redundancy

evidence.text: How can boundary-operator smearing reconstruct gauge and gravitational bulk fields, and what physical meaning and locality remain after gauge fixing and imposing Gauss-law constraints?

sources.title: Holographic representation of bulk fields with spin in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can bulk spin-one and spin-two fields be represented as smeared CFT operators, and which notions of locality survive gauge redundancy, interactions in 1/N perturbation theory, and extensions beyond a fixed AdS background?

sources.title: The Gravity Dual of a Density Matrix

evidence.text: Given a boundary subregion density matrix ρ_A in a state with a classical geometric AdS/CFT dual, what is the largest bulk region fully reconstructible from it, equivalently common to all geometric duals compatible with that density matrix?

sources.title: CFT representation of interacting bulk gauge fields in AdS

evidence.text: How can interacting AdS gauge fields and charged matter be reconstructed from CFT observables while imposing the microcausality compatible with gauge constraints and Wilson-line dressing?

sources.title: Generalized gravitational entropy

evidence.text: Can Euclidean gravitational entropy be defined without a circle-translation Killing symmetry, and can a gravitational replica construction explain why the entropy is given by a codimension-two minimal-surface area?

sources.title: Cool horizons for entangled black holes

evidence.text: How does entanglement determine Einstein–Rosen bridges and black-hole interiors, and does entanglement with a distant system require a firewall? The paper tests AMPS/AMPSS reasoning in two-sided black-hole models and proposes extensions to evaporating holes.

sources.title: Decoding the hologram: Scalar fields interacting with gravity

evidence.text: How can smeared CFT operators represent an AdS scalar interacting with gravity while satisfying the appropriate spacelike commutation relations and transforming correctly under AdS isometries?

sources.title: Unitary S Matrices With Long-Range Correlations and the Quantum Black Hole

evidence.text: Can long-range correlations between incoming and outgoing black-hole states be incorporated into a unitary S matrix at intermediate evaporation stages, and what changes to causality and complementarity would this require?

sources.title: Multiboundary Wormholes and Holographic Entanglement

evidence.text: How do the conformal moduli of Euclidean preparation surfaces control bulk connectivity and the bipartite versus multipartite entanglement of multiboundary holographic states?

sources.title: Jerusalem Lectures on Black Holes and Quantum Information

evidence.text: How can black-hole evaporation preserve quantum information while allowing a smooth experience for an infalling observer, and how do quantum information theory and holography sharpen this problem?

sources.title: Bulk Locality and Quantum Error Correction in AdS/CFT

evidence.text: How can approximate bulk locality, especially radial locality and reconstruction on overlapping boundary regions, emerge when the full CFT operator algebra cannot obey the apparent bulk commutation relations?

sources.title: Entanglement entropy in three dimensional gravity

evidence.text: How can regulated geodesic lengths and holographic interval entropies be computed efficiently in topologically complicated pure three-dimensional gravity, and under what conditions can Euclidean calculations justify covariant HRT?

sources.title: Inviolable energy conditions from entanglement inequalities

evidence.text: Which necessary constraints on nonlinear bulk geometries follow from strong subadditivity and positivity/monotonicity of boundary relative entropy, and how can Einstein's equations express these constraints as energy conditions?

sources.title: Further Holographic Investigations of Big Bang Singularities

evidence.text: Can boundary two-point functions identify the Kasner-AdS initial singularity, and what does their behavior imply about the CFT state selected by the geodesic approximation?

sources.title: Hot multiboundary wormholes from bipartite entanglement

evidence.text: What spatial and multipartite entanglement structure prepares hot, time-symmetric multiboundary AdS3 wormholes, and how accurately can their dual CFT states be assembled from thermofield doubles?

sources.title: Diffeomorphism-invariant observables and their nonlocal algebra

evidence.text: How can diffeomorphism-invariant operators create a particle together with its gravitational field, reduce to ordinary field operators as gravity weakens, and what locality properties does their observable algebra possess?

sources.title: Holographic Complexity Equals Bulk Action?

evidence.text: Is holographic-state computational complexity dual to the action of a Wheeler–DeWitt patch, and do black-hole action-growth calculations support a universal maximal rate of computation?

sources.title: A Measure of de Sitter entropy and eternal inflation

evidence.text: Replace a model-specific fluctuation analysis by the adiabatic time-shift sector of a spatial-diffeomorphism-invariant effective action. This isolates a necessary source of dangerous fluctuations without requiring a complete microscopic matter Lagrangian.

sources.title: Are we typical?

evidence.text: Choose and disclose a theory-prior weighting that implements the desired typicality preference, then update it using the ordinary data likelihood. The procedure separates preference from evidence and exposes how conclusions depend on that preference.

sources.title: A Covariant holographic entanglement entropy proposal

evidence.text: Compare the radial metric factor with its pure-AdS value pointwise, then test the subtracted radial integral at zero and infinity. The explicit convergence conditions are added in the analytical reconstruction.

sources.title: An area law for one-dimensional quantum systems

evidence.text: Convert approximate ground-state projection into Schmidt-tail information, then sum shellwise entropy bounds. The operation separates an overlap assumption from the local Hamiltonian structure needed to turn it into a uniform entropy estimate.

sources.title: On Super-Planckian Fields at Sub-Planckian Energies

evidence.text: A spherical-harmonic expansion shows that higher multipoles increase the Newtonian potential without changing the single-field origin-to-infinity excursion. A fixed-backreaction variational problem then selects a logarithmic radial profile after introducing a short-distance cutoff.

sources.title: Relative entropy and the Bekenstein bound

evidence.text: Regularize localization by tracing over the complement of V, then subtract the entropy and modular-energy expectation of the vacuum reduced to the identical region. Define the modular Hamiltonian through ρ0V=exp(−K)/tr exp(−K).

sources.title: Non-equilibrium dynamics in Holography

evidence.text: Can entanglement entropy in DS/dS constrain the matter content of de Sitter quantum gravity? The thesis proposes such a criterion to investigate qualitative swampland claims within a specified holographic framework.

destination.title: Spacetime topology, gravitational histories and causal access
destination.question: Under which geometric, matter, boundary and quantum prescriptions do spacetime constructions exist, admit causal access or contribute to gravitational amplitudes, and how should their state and effective-theory effects be interpreted?
destination.summary: Separate construction and regularity from causal accessibility, contour admissibility, topology weighting and quantum interpretation. These related targets need different evidence.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Do Euclidean wormholes contribute to physical quantum gravity, and can their effects coexist with local effective field theory? The review treats censorship, baby-universe states, and the interpretation of coupling constants as unresolved questions even for large, low-curvature configurations.

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: Does eliminating quotient fixed points eliminate causal pathology? Grant space shows that a smooth quotient can still contain CTCs, including curves through regions where the identification generator itself is spacelike.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Can the axion and dilaton fields of a string compactification support a smooth Euclidean throat? The relevant classical equations use an indefinite scalar metric obtained by continuing the axionic variables while retaining ordinary dilaton kinetic signs.

sources.title: k-Essence, superluminal propagation, causality and emergent geometry

evidence.text: Can physically realizable evolution form acoustic closed causal curves outside the backgrounds covered by temporal-function proofs? The paper invokes quantum backreaction by analogy with gravitational chronology protection.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Does quantum gravity permit low-energy topology change in four and higher dimensions, and what determines the resulting baby-universe state? If it forbids these processes, a censorship mechanism and alternative UV-independent axionic symmetry-breaking objects are needed.

sources.title: Traversable wormholes in four dimensions

evidence.text: Can ordinary charged quantum fields support a parametrically controlled, traversable four-dimensional wormhole without creating a shortcut through ambient space, and can its mouths and throat remain metastable?

sources.title: Traversable wormholes in AdS and bounds on information transfer

evidence.text: How much information can traverse a Gao–Jafferis–Wall wormhole while a controlled semiclassical bulk description remains valid, despite its very short opening, and how does this depend on black-hole size, species number and transverse localization?

sources.title: Closed Timelike Curves, Singularities and Causality: A Survey from Gödel to Chronological Protection

evidence.text: Historical survey of how closed timelike curves (CTCs), spacetime singularities and traversable wormholes bear on backward time travel, and whether classical, semiclassical or quantum-gravity mechanisms protect chronology.

sources.title: Gauging spacetime inversions in quantum gravity

evidence.text: What does gauging spacetime inversions, especially antiunitary CRT, mean for topology sums, quantum fields on time-unorientable spacetimes, causality, and quantum mechanics in closed universes?

sources.title: Wormhole Renormalization: The gravitational path integral, holography, and a gauge group for topology change

evidence.text: Can effects of unknown microscopic wormholes be parametrized recursively, analogously to renormalization counterterms, to restore holographic factorization? What Hopf algebra and topology-changing group organize equivalent gravitational path-integral prescriptions?

sources.title: Unitary time-reversal on non-orientable spacetimes

evidence.text: Can a reversal of temporal orientation encoded in spacetime topology permit a linear unitary realization of time reversal, with positive- and negative-energy partners, in place of the conventional anti-unitary operation?

sources.title: There is no R**3 x S**1 vacuum gravitational instanton

evidence.text: Can a nonflat vacuum gravitational instanton exist on R^3 × S^1 with asymptotically flat noncompact directions and a fixed Euclidean period only near infinity?

sources.title: Topological censorship

evidence.text: Can observers actively probe nontrivial spacetime topology using causal signals arriving from past null infinity and returning to future null infinity? The paper seeks sufficient causal and energy hypotheses forbidding such probes.

sources.title: Dominant topologies in Euclidean quantum gravity

evidence.text: Which spacetime topologies dominate the four-dimensional Euclidean gravitational path integral for each sign of Λ, and can topology multiplicity overwhelm action suppression? The paper explores implications for spacetime foam, the cosmological constant, and the Hartle–Hawking wave function.

sources.title: Instantons and wormholes in Minkowski and (A)dS spaces

evidence.text: When do Euclidean instantons and nonsingular, finite-action wormholes exist in d-dimensional axion-dilaton gravity with zero, negative or positive cosmological constant, and how does existence depend on the dilaton coupling?

sources.title: Non-extremal instantons and wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Which non-extremal, spherically symmetric Euclidean gravity–dilaton–axion solutions exist, when are they completely regular wormholes, and can such wormholes occur in Calabi–Yau compactifications of string theory?

sources.title: The AdS / CFT correspondence conjecture and topological censorship

evidence.text: How strongly does topological censorship constrain the topology of Lorentzian asymptotically AdS interiors and black-hole exteriors from the topology of their timelike boundary, in arbitrary dimension and especially in 2+1 and 4+1 dimensions?

sources.title: A Short Review of Time Dependent Solutions and Space-like Singularities in String Theory

evidence.text: Transfer a known electric-field oscillator realization to the twisted closed-string algebra, specifying the Hilbert space and ordering. This operation addresses fixed-background quantization; it supplies neither a unique spacetime vacuum nor a backreacted singularity resolution.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes in string theory

evidence.text: Fourier project onto charges before extremizing, vary endpoint values as integration variables, solve the resulting complex equations, and retain all boundary terms in the weight. For wormholes, only dilatons must interpolate continuously between the specified physical end data.

sources.title: k-Essence, superluminal propagation, causality and emergent geometry

evidence.text: Match the principal and first-derivative parts of the scalar operator to an emergent covariant d'Alembertian. Solve for its conformal normalization using the determinant and derivative-Hessian identities.

sources.title: Euclidean wormholes, baby universes, and their impact on particle physics and cosmology

evidence.text: Derive the reparametrization constraint, reinterpret its solution as a field, and introduce interactions representing topology change. This supplies a dynamical alternative to simply integrating static α parameters.

sources.title: Traversable wormholes in four dimensions

evidence.text: Match approximate solutions in three overlapping regions: the perturbed AdS₂×S² throat, each nearly extremal black-hole mouth and the approximately Newtonian exterior. Determine throat length both by an energy-minimization ansatz and by solving semiclassical Einstein equations with the quantum stress tensor.

sources.title: Traversable wormholes in AdS and bounds on information transfer

evidence.text: Signals are modeled as positive-energy shocks. Bounds combine small gravitational time delays, uncertainty-principle localization and angular-momentum escape conditions. A separate shock-gluing calculation uses radius continuity, DTR matching and positive black-hole patch masses.
